caption: The drawing depicts a single object centered on a plain, light-colored background. The object consists of a vertical cylindrical tube with a small, horizontally extending spout at the top. The cylinder is mounted on a flat, circular base that is wider than the tube, giving it stability. The drawing is executed in shades of gray and black, creating a monochrome appearance. The light source appears to come from the top left, casting subtle shadows along the right side of the object and base, which provides a three-dimensional effect. The lower right corner of the drawing contains a small, neatly written signature that reads "Holger Hansen." The background is mostly empty except for some faint smudges and discoloration, particularly toward the top and bottom edges.
title: Candlestick
